name: mirage
text: The engine is running fine (scanning, 408 +EV lines, about 150 listed). It isn't ordering because the Vigilant wallet has $0.00 cash. Your $233 is all tied up in open bets, so there's nothing free to bet or bid with. It's waiting on 808 bids it can't fund. It starts again by itself as soon as cash comes back, from settled bets or a deposit. Do you want me to look at why so much is sitting in open bets, or loosen the cash reserve?
